{{Top|leg}}
The '''Diamond Desert''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]]. Durace's abnormal geothermal forces compressed the black sands of the desert into rare jewels, including [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]]. Jewels could be found strewn across the desert's dunes and were often sold for high prices on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] market. Predators that dwelt in the Diamond Desert sometimes used these gems as bait, using the jewels to lure their prey to them.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
